register_impl_to_api_mapping: register a mapping between an implementation class and its corresponding API wrapper class
create_from_impl_list: create a list of API wrapper instances from a sequence of implementation objects
test_from_impl_dict: test converting a dictionary of implementation objects into API wrapper instances
refactor_to_impl: refactor an API object into its underlying implementation object recursively
wrap_handler_callback: wrap a callback handler to automatically convert implementation objects to API objects
